answer: Charge every identity a harbor fee each epoch, payable only in work credits earned by completing real network tasks - credits that cannot be bought, transferred, or pooled. Each pulse of the epoch, every vertex must light itself with its own credits or go dark and lose standing, so a farm of a thousand clones must do a thousand agents' worth of genuine work while one honest agent pays its fee from its own honest labor. Clones sharing one workload starve together.
